summary.one_line: The predictor player package instructions match the shared-helper loader and clearly mark live launch as unverified.

purpose.evidence: Read README.md, the only changed Markdown file, against the new loader source and pinned devkit helper. It now describes a player-facing preview package while retaining separate developer build/live-test instructions. The package is marked as being prepared for Releases rather than available or stable today.

structure.evidence: RU and EN add a player-package section with install/use/disable/remove steps ahead of the existing source-build and verification material. Compatibility and pinned devkit revision are kept nearby. A separate launcher-check note explains --check without presenting it as in-game acceptance. CMake still emits and installs the DLL and loader together.

specificity.evidence: The folder instruction matches universe_player::SelectGame: a Heroes5DeploymentPreview directory beside game bin lets the loader find its parent bin/H5_Game.exe, otherwise it opens a file picker. Loader parses no-argument player mode, --game, --pid and --check, verifies four pinned game binary hashes and the neighboring WorkshopDeploymentPreview.dll, and uses RequireGameClosed before starting. README correctly says DLL is not placed in UserMODs and ordinary EXE startup disables the plugin.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports the x86 pair built with the new pinned devkit revision, all nine predictor checks passed locally with the game EXE oracle, and a candidate ZIP extracted to a Unicode path passed --check with only system Windows PATH and no H5/Python environment. This proves packaging/binary pairing, not the new double-click path in a live game; README explicitly says that path lacks fresh live acceptance. No game was launched by this reviewer.

evidence.evidence: The exact diff replaces duplicate in-loader hashing with the shared devkit/native/player_launch.hpp helper and wires bcrypt/comdlg32/user32 in CMake. ParseArguments selects the adjacent game or file picker for no args; checkOnly returns after supported game/plugin-file validation without CreateProcess. Normal launch retains mod-specific injection logic. I relied on parent candidate-ZIP checks and did not inspect private game files or profile contents.

applicability.evidence: README targets the four-hash pinned Universe build, rejects mismatches, warns against replacing original game DLLs and says combined use with bank reference is unverified. The player pair needs no Python/Git/build tools, while developer tests do. It distinguishes prior historical game results, isolated nine-test evidence and the untested new double-click launch path.

translations.evidence: RU and EN player sections agree on a pending Releases package, source ZIP not being an installer, two adjacent files, parent-bin search/file picker, no Python, hash rejection, ordinary-EXE disable, folder removal and no fresh live acceptance. Developer verification in both languages retains nine checks and one permitted absent-game oracle skip. No material mismatch found.

maintenance.evidence: README updates the tested devkit gitlink from 1b8934a to 587e09c and pairs the new shared native API with player instructions. Source and game files remain separate; candidate package is not tracked as a game distribution. review:info lists only README.md for this exact diff and it is covered here. No source file was edited by this reviewer.
